properties.name: Front Range
properties.note: Mummy Range and RMNP east and divide, Indian Peaks, James Peak, Berthoud, Jones and Loveland passes, Grays/Torreys, Mount Evans/Blue Sky, Guanella and Kenosha, Pikes Peak.
properties.definition: App-defined approximate reporting region; not an official, land-management or CAIC forecast boundary.

properties.name: Summit / Tenmile
properties.note: Keystone, Arapahoe Basin side, Montezuma, Tenmile Range, Vail Pass recreation area, Breckenridge, Hoosier and Fremont passes, and the Mosquito Range.
properties.definition: App-defined approximate reporting region; not an official, land-management or CAIC forecast boundary.

properties.name: Vail / Eagle / Gore
properties.note: Gore Range, Vail and Beaver Creek backcountry, Holy Cross Wilderness, Camp Hale and Tennessee Pass.
properties.definition: App-defined approximate reporting region; not an official, land-management or CAIC forecast boundary.

properties.name: Sawatch
properties.note: Leadville, Mount Elbert, Independence Pass east side and crest, Collegiate Peaks, Cottonwood Pass, Monarch and Marshall passes.
properties.definition: App-defined approximate reporting region; not an official, land-management or CAIC forecast boundary.

properties.name: Elk Mountains
properties.note: Aspen, Maroon Bells, Marble, Crested Butte, Gothic, Kebler Pass and the West Elk Mountains, Sunlight.
properties.definition: App-defined approximate reporting region; not an official, land-management or CAIC forecast boundary.

properties.name: San Juans
properties.note: Red Mountain, Coal Bank, Molas, Lizard Head and Wolf Creek passes, Ouray, Silverton, Telluride, Lake City, Creede, La Plata Mountains, Cumbres Pass.
properties.definition: App-defined approximate reporting region; not an official, land-management or CAIC forecast boundary.

properties.name: Northern: Park Range / Rabbit Ears / Cameron Pass / Never Summer / Flat Tops
properties.note: Steamboat, Buffalo and Rabbit Ears passes, Mount Zirkel, Cameron Pass, Never Summer Mountains, and the Flat Tops (grouped here as CAIC groups Steamboat and Flat Tops).
properties.definition: App-defined approximate reporting region; not an official, land-management or CAIC forecast boundary.

properties.name: Sangre de Cristo / Wet Mountains / Spanish Peaks
properties.note: Added because it is a distinct mountain region with backcountry skiing (Crestones, Blanca, Cuchara, Spanish Peaks) that fits no named region.
properties.definition: App-defined approximate reporting region; not an official, land-management or CAIC forecast boundary.

properties.name: Grand Mesa
properties.note: Added because Grand Mesa is a distinct, well-used winter touring area (Skyway, Mesa Lakes, Powderhorn) and its own CAIC zone; it fits no named region.
properties.definition: App-defined approximate reporting region; not an official, land-management or CAIC forecast boundary.

properties.name: Other Colorado
properties.note: Remainder of the Colorado bounding box (plains, parks, plateaus, lower foothills).
properties.definition: App-defined approximate reporting region; not an official, land-management or CAIC forecast boundary.
